class.name: SpineSlotNode2D
class.brief_description: Inserts child nodes into a [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] draw order at a skeleton slot.
class.description: [code]SpineSlotNode2D[/code] is a child of [code]SpineSprite2D[/code]. Set [code]slot_name[/code] to a skeleton slot. The node follows the slot bone transform each frame. Child [code]Node2D[/code] nodes draw inside the sprite draw order at [code]slot_name[/code]. They render above the slot attachment. Attach particles, collision shapes, labels, or nested [code]SpineSprite2D[/code] nodes this way. The Materials group overrides the attachment material for this slot only. Each property matches a Spine blend mode: normal, additive, multiply, or screen. Unset properties keep the sprite default material for this slot.

members.member: Material for the slot attachment when the slot blend mode is additive.
Material for the slot attachment when the slot blend mode is multiply.
Material for the slot attachment when the slot blend mode is normal.
Material for the slot attachment when the slot blend mode is screen.
Skeleton slot where this node enters the draw order. The inspector lists slot names from the parent sprite skeleton data.
